OverHistory.UPDCommentry:
TREMENDOUS REVIEW AND ENGLAND DRAW FIRST BLOOD! Gus Atkinson bowling to Yashasvi Jaiswal, good length ball, pitching outside off stump, the ball nipping in, beats Jaiswal on his defence, he is caught in his crease. Initially it looked like like double sound and the decision was turned down, England go upstairs and the replay shows three reds! Atkinson strikes early on his return! 

WICKET Yashasvi Jaiswal lbw Gus Atkinson (India 10 Runs for 1 wickets)
